title: Sampling and material fidelity
start_policy: Start now using published candidates, frozen inputs, or explicit local proxies; integration_inputs are convergence obligations, not start gates.
scope: Own sRGB/linear handling, filtering, mip/LOD, tangent basis, texel density, source UV preservation, and stretch diagnostics.

Own sampling, resolve/downsample, and post-sharpen policy and shaders through Q0 interfaces; compare baseline, anisotropy, mip bias, MSAA, supersampling, downsampling, sharpening, and conservative combined settings.
acceptance: Detail survives both zooms without shimmer, exaggerated normals, clipped contrast, nonuniform source-body distortion, or out-of-bounds UV anisotropy.

The cached mixed-content sharpness fixture has one-variable A/B evidence, effective settings, equal final sizes, unsharpened controls, scrolling inspection, GPU time and memory, and a justified finalist without halos, ringing, alpha/viewport-edge damage, or crawling detail.
